parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ACK cluster ID. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAckClusters](~~DescribeAckClusters~~): Queries the list of ACK clusters.

parameters.name: ConnectorName
parameters.description: The name of the ACK cluster connector. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: MemberUid
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the account to which the ACK cluster resource belongs.

parameters.name: PrimaryVswitchId
parameters.description:
The primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~): Queries the list of synchronization node vSwitches.

parameters.name: PrimaryVswitchIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the primary vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector.

parameters.name: RegionNo
parameters.description:
The region ID of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceRegionList~~): Queries the list of synchronization node regions.

> For more information about the regions supported by ACK cluster connectors in Cloud Firewall, see [ACK cluster synchronization nodes](~~2865120~~).

parameters.name: StandbyVswitchId
parameters.description:
The standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector. You can call the following operation to obtain the value:
- [DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList](~~DescribeAccessInstanceVSwitchList~~): Queries the list of synchronization node vSwitches.

parameters.name: StandbyVswitchIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the standby vSwitch of the ACK cluster connector.

parameters.name: Ttl
parameters.description: The synchronization interval of the ACK cluster connector. Valid values: 2 to 60. Unit: seconds.
